## Linear Content

Thoughts on language, markets, numeric computations, among other things.

### Focus Areas

- **AI & NLP**: Making machines read so I don't have to.
- **Stats & ML**: Interesting applications, questionable utility, intuition included.
- **Markets & Investing**: Because money, code and text mix well together.
- **Occasional Musings**: Random thoughts, powered by LLMs.

### Philosophy

Linear content: the tangent line at a point of interest. Take complicated systems and find the local approximation that's useful enough. Taylor expansions with n=1, because the first derivative usually carries most of the information anyway.
